messages.content: Answer with one JSON object and nothing else.

From this invoice, give the invoice number, the seller and the total due as JSON with keys number, seller, total.

Invoice INV-2207 from Blue Pine Supplies, dated 2031-03-14. Items: 3 notebooks at 4.50 each, 2 pens at 1.25 each. Total due: 16.00. Pay within 30 days.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else.

Give the invoice date as JSON with the single key date, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

Invoice INV-2207 from Blue Pine Supplies, dated 2031-03-14. Items: 3 notebooks at 4.50 each, 2 pens at 1.25 each. Total due: 16.00. Pay within 30 days.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else.

Give only the number of pens on this invoice as JSON with the single key pens. Add no other keys.

Invoice INV-2207 from Blue Pine Supplies, dated 2031-03-14. Items: 3 notebooks at 4.50 each, 2 pens at 1.25 each. Total due: 16.00. Pay within 30 days.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else.

Extract the name and the city as JSON with keys name and city. Do not add any other key, even if more is known.

Note: Mira Holt moved to Lakeview last spring; she is 41 and works as a baker.
Describe a lighthouse in at most ten words. Reply with the description only.
Reply with exactly one word: the colour of a clear daytime sky.
What is 47 + 38? Reply with the number only.
A box holds 12 jars. How many jars are in 9 boxes? Reply with the number only.

On this invoice, do the items add up to the total due? Reply with yes or no, then the items' sum.

Invoice INV-2207 from Blue Pine Supplies, dated 2031-03-14. Items: 3 notebooks at 4.50 each, 2 pens at 1.25 each. Total due: 16.00. Pay within 30 days.
Sort these words alphabetically and reply with them separated by commas, nothing else: pear, apple, mango, cherry
Sort these numbers from largest to smallest and reply with them separated by commas, nothing else: 7, 42, 3, 19
The note says: 'The meeting moved to Thursday.' At what time is the meeting? If the note does not say, reply exactly: not stated
